description: The calls that create a DEX pool's vaults on gage, one for each pool token gage lends, each on its own factory, from any curator while its creation is open (mainnet's since 5 November 2026), otherwise one gage admitted as a partner: what both share named once (fee, longest loan, Loan grade floor, priority fee), and for each token its largest loan and the cash it keeps free. Neither vault lends against the pool's own two tokens unless a side names one and allowPoolTokens is true. Answers the calls for one wallet batch (EIP-5792, atomic) and the same as a Safe{Wallet} Transaction Builder file (safeBatch), each simulated from the curator now; a token gage does not lend gets no vault, and the answer says why. Never signs.

allowPoolTokens.description: true lets a side's collateral name one of the pool's own two tokens, which a fall in that token would then hit twice: in the pool and in the vault's loans. When omitted or false, naming one is refused (POOL_TOKEN_COLLATERAL); a side that names no collateral never lends against them either way

buyLoans.description: Each vault buys running loans other vaults of its generation sell, when they pay at least the model's return plus this; off when omitted. Before mandate 13 (Intent D56) only the USDG vault buys

extraBps.description: The extra return a year asked above the model's, bps

curator.description: Who manages both vaults, for good: the wallet or Safe that sends the calls. Any address while a generation's creation is open (mainnet's since 5 November 2026), otherwise one gage admitted as a partner there

feeBps.description: The performance fee both charge on each loan's profit, bps, 500 to 1500; the protocol receives 10% of it

minRateGrade.description: The lowest Loan grade both fund, 0 (any) to 4 (A, the model's price or more). 3 (B, 90% of it) when omitted

name.description: The name before the pool's tag: "Fables" names both vaults "Fables NVDA/USDG"

pool.description: The pool's two tokens, in its order

prefixItems.description: A token of the pool: a lend asset's symbol or address (USDG, or one gage_capabilities lists under lendAssets), or any token's address
A token of the pool: a lend asset's symbol or address (USDG, or one gage_capabilities lists under lendAssets), or any token's address

priorityFeeBps.description: The most each vault pays the protocol for a loan, bps of its profit, 0 to 5000: the vault paying most is funded first. 2000 when omitted

sides.description: What is counted in each token, one entry for each pool token gage lends: its largest loan, and the cash it keeps free

cashKeptFreeBps.description: The share of the vault a new loan must leave free in cash, bps, 0 to 10000: what the pool can draw on. 1000 (10%) when omitted

collateral.description: The tokens this vault lends against, of one universe (real-world assets, or the Robinhood ecosystem). When omitted: every token its generation admits in the universe of the pool's other token, less the pool's own two tokens (a stock's vault: the memes paired with it). Naming a pool token is refused unless allowPoolTokens is true

maxLoan.description: The most this vault puts into one loan, raw units of its token (USDG: 6 decimals)

token.description: The pool token this side lends, as `pool` names it

term.description: The longest loan both vaults fund, in seconds: 604800 (7 days) or 1814400 (21 days)

name: gage_create_pool_vaults
title: Create pool vaults
